prs.title: Add per-tenant rate limiting to ingest API
prs.body:
## Summary
Adds a per-tenant token bucket in front of the ingest API so one noisy tenant can't starve the WAL writer for everyone else. Requests over the limit get a `429` with a `Retry-After` hint.

## Changes
- `internal/ratelimit`: token bucket with burst support and a `Limiter` that keeps one bucket per tenant
- Idle buckets are evicted by a background sweep (default TTL 10m)
- `internal/ingest`: rate-limit check ahead of batch decoding; per-tenant overrides via `tenant.RateLimit`
- Prometheus counters for allowed/rejected requests, labelled by tenant
- `docs/rate-limiting.md` and a README/CHANGELOG entry

Responses on `/v1/events` now carry:

| Header | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Sustained events/sec allowed for the tenant |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Tokens left in the bucket after this request |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` | Seconds until the bucket is full again |
| `Retry-After` | Seconds to wait before retrying (only on `429`) |

## Config
| Variable | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `TIDEPOOL_DEFAULT_RATE_LIMIT_EPS` | `1000` | Default sustained rate per tenant (events/sec) |
| `TIDEPOOL_DEFAULT_RATE_LIMIT_BURST` | `2000` | Default burst size per tenant |

Tenants with their own `rate_limit` in the tenant config override both.

## Testing
- Unit tests for refill, burst, and concurrent `Allow` calls (`go test -race ./internal/ratelimit/...`)
- Ran against staging with the replay harness at 3x peak traffic; rejected requests were all from the throttled tenant
prs.author: sarahhill

reviews.author: jcole
reviews.body: Left a few comments, mostly around the refill clock and what a token represents.

comments.author: jcole
comments.body: Should refill use a monotonic clock? time.Now() will jump on NTP sync and either starve or flood the bucket.

comments.author: sarahhill
comments.body: Good catch — switched to the injected clock's monotonic reading in 3b0de4e.

comments.author: jcole
comments.body: This charges one token per request, but the limit is documented in events/sec. A 500-event batch costs the same as a single event.

comments.author: sarahhill
comments.body: Intentional for v1 — batches are capped at 1k events by the handler. I'd rather ship request-based limits now and follow up with weighted cost.

comments.author: jcole
comments.body: nit: 10m eviction feels long for tenants that burst once a day — maybe make it configurable?

comments.author: tbaker
comments.body: Ran this against staging with the replay harness — p99 ingest latency unchanged (4.1ms → 4.2ms). 👍

prs.title: Regenerate protobufs for v2 event schema
prs.body:
Regenerated `gen/` with protoc-gen-go v1.35.2 via `buf generate`. No hand edits.

- Picks up the v2 `Event` schema (`attributes` map, `received_at`)
- Bumps the generated header, hence the large file count

To reproduce: `make proto` on a clean checkout produces an identical tree.
prs.author: tbaker

reviews.author: bhughes
reviews.body: Spot-checked the schema diff, generated output matches `make proto`.

prs.title: Fix WAL segment fsync on rotation
prs.body:
## Summary
When a WAL segment rotates we closed the old file without syncing it, so a crash right after rotation could lose the tail of the previous segment even though the writer had acked it.

## Changes
- fsync the segment (and its directory entry) before opening the next one
- Regression test that kills the writer mid-rotation

## Testing
`go test -race ./internal/wal/...`
prs.author: kmiller

prs.title: Propagate W3C trace context through router
prs.body:
Extracts `traceparent` on ingest and carries it on each routed event so spans from sinks link back to the originating request.

- New `trace` helper in the router
- Events without a header start a new root span

Follow-up: propagate through the webhook sink headers.

prs.title: Add jitter to Kafka sink retry backoff
prs.body:
Retries after a broker blip all fired on the same exponential schedule, which caused a thundering herd on reconnect. Adds full jitter (`rand(0, backoff)`) and caps at 30s.

Test: table test over seeded RNG checking bounds.

prs.title: Respect Retry-After on 429 responses
prs.body:
The client retried 429s on its own backoff and ignored `Retry-After`. It now honours the header (seconds or HTTP-date) for 429 and 503, falling back to backoff when absent.

Needed for tidepool#482 which starts returning it.
prs.author: aclark

prs.title: Add batching client with flush on size or interval
prs.body: Adds `Batcher`, which buffers events and flushes when either `MaxBatch` events are queued or `FlushInterval` elapses, whichever comes first. `Close` flushes and waits.
